pages.title: Rebuilding
pages.text: Breaking took me a month. Rebuilding took nine years.$(br2)Compounds, distortion fluid and a base block become an item again.
Its catalyst gives matter a shape to come back into, and the base block is that shape.

pages.title: Molds
pages.text: The base is the mold. Stone gives raw ore, cobblestone an ingot or a gem, deepslate a whole ore. Soul sand or soul soil gives back a creature's drop.$(br2)Netherite would only come back through netherrack, as an ingot.

pages.name: Reconstruction Chamber
pages.text: A cottage around a cauldron on a campfire.

pages.title: The Cottage
pages.text: Oak planks, logs and stairs, bookshelves, glass panes, barrels with potted flowers, lanterns, a water cauldron over a campfire, and one plank that becomes a beehive when it wakes.

pages.title: Its Habits
pages.text: It drinks distortion fluid by bucket or pipe, and the cauldron behind the core shows how much is left.$(br2)Candles light themselves and a spore blossom opens when it wakes. Like every core, it starves without a $(l:energy/wormholes)wormhole$() above it.
